question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Build castles in the air
solution:
The correct answer is **"To make imaginary schemes". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Build castles in the air" means to make plans or dreams that are unrealistic or have very little chance of happening. (हवा में महल बनाना - ऐसी योजनाएं या सपने बनाना जो अवास्तविक हों या जिनके होने की संभावना बहुत कम हो।)
 
 
• Example: He spends most of his time building castles in the air instead of working towards achievable goals.
 
 
 
• Explanation of the correct word: "To make imaginary schemes" refers to creating plans or ideas that are purely based on imagination and are not grounded in reality. (काल्पनिक योजनाएं बनाना - ऐसी योजनाएं या विचार बनाना जो केवल कल्पना पर आधारित हों और वास्तविकता में नहीं।)
 
 
• Example: Dreaming about winning the lottery without buying a ticket is like making imaginary schemes.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is- **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• To make useless efforts implies exerting energy or effort into tasks or endeavors that do not yield any beneficial results. (व्यर्थ प्रयास करना - ऐसे कामों में ऊर्जा या प्रयास लगाना जो कोई लाभकारी परिणाम नहीं देते।)
 
• To talk pointlessly means to engage in conversation that has no purpose or value; speaking without conveying meaningful information. (बेकार की बातें करना - ऐसी बातचीत में लगे रहना जिसका कोई उद्देश्य या मूल्य नहीं हो; बिना किसी सार्थक जानकारी के बोलना।)
 
• To build a palatial house refers to the actual construction of a grand and spacious residence that resembles a palace. (राजमहल जैसा घर बनाना - एक विशाल और भव्य निवास का वास्तविक निर्माण जो एक महल के समान हो।)
